Inference: no ship-order constraint and no schema effect: install_block.py and scripts/safe_write.py change in one commit (2b1929a), the harness copies the whole tree (.gitattributes:1-2), and the installer loads safe_write from its own tree (install_block.py:27, :33); the instruction-file bytes it writes keep their shape.

No FRESHNESS.md registry row names scripts/safe_write.py; the install_block.py row (FRESHNESS.md:69) lists triggers the move does not touch. Whether the same-commit rule needed a new row is not checked.
The new tests on Linux and macOS (owner-only mode, flock path) and the smoke tier hooks/tests/hook-smoke.sh were not run by this tracer.

claims.text: The lock-file name `.<name>.afk.lock` is unchanged by the move, so an older installer and the moved writer still exclude each other on one file; three installer tests and one safe-writer test pin the name.

On Windows a busy os.replace (PermissionError) was an OSError before the move and is now retried 10 times then raised as InstallError('target file swap stayed busy: <path>'); the CLI exits 2 either way, and no in-tree code catches OSError or ValueError around an installer call outside the installer itself and its tests.
